chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked him about the fingers: is there for some of them an excess over others in the indemnity? He said: “They are equal in the indemnity.”

key_terms.الدِّيَةِ: financial indemnity payable for bodily injury
key_terms.الْأَصَابِعِ: the fingers, the bodily members being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.سَوَاءٌ: equal, without distinction in legal valuation
key_terms.فَضْلٌ: an excess or preference in value over another

ai.seo_question: Are some fingers worth more than others in diya according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning diya for fingers. It establishes that the fingers are treated equally in indemnity, with no finger having preference over another in this ruling.
